keySentence: Jack traded the cow for magic beans.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The man said, "These are magic." Jack was happy. He took the beans. Jack traded the cow for magic beans.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: "These are special magic beans," said the old man. Jack's eyes opened wide. He loved magic. He gave the cow. Jack traded the cow for magic beans.
facts.Word cards: magic = 마법 / special = 특별한 / bean = 콩 / cow = 소
